Home.faqQ1: Do the resources follow the Moroccan curriculum?
Home.faqA1: Yes, the main classification follows the levels and chapters of the Moroccan curriculum.
Home.faqQ2: Is the site useful outside Morocco?
Home.faqA2: Yes, the math courses and exercises remain useful for French-speaking students in other countries.
Home.faqA3: Yes, all Maths-Exams resources are free to access. No registration is required to view courses and exercises.
